title: "How Do I Get into Research?" Panel
text:
OPTIONAL
Last Updated Sep 14, 2026 11:28 AM
Academics, Research, & Scholarship: "How Do I Get into Research?" Panel
 BACK TO PATH

Interested in getting involved in research but unsure where to begin? "How Do I Get into Research?" is designed to help students learn how to find research opportunities, reach out to professors and potential mentors, and take their first steps into undergraduate research.

 

The event will feature three Honors College students who are currently involved in research, who will share their experiences, how they got started, and advice they wish they had known beforehand. Students will also have the opportunity to ask questions and hear different perspectives on navigating the research process.

 

Instructions to get to the location: Go to the Parkview building next to the preserve and ask the front desk about the Sky Lounge on the third floor.

 

Open to all students!

 

Academics, Research, & Scholarship Credit!

 

Should you need ADA accommodation to participate in a University event, program, or activity or need to request materials in an accessible format, please contact FIU's Office of Civil Rights Compliance and Accessibility (CRCA) at 305-348-2785 or accomodations@fiu.edu. All requests for ADA accommodation or accessible materials for this event must be submitted to CRCA at least (7) business days prior to the event or at the earliest opportunity.

title: Serve in FIU Student Government Association
text:
OPTIONAL
Last Updated Sep 14, 2026 11:28 AM
Career & Professional Development: Serve in FIU Student Government Association
 BACK TO PATH

Take part in the FIU Student Government as a senator, representative, or officer.  

 

Additional Information 

Contact: Student Government Association 

 

FIU SGA represents the interests of students at the Modesto A. Maidique Campus, Biscayne Bay Campus, Engineering Center, and FIU at I-75. In coherence with the idea of checks and balances, SGA is divided into the Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches. 

Together, SGA exists to represent students and act in their best interests on academic, extracurricular and social issues. Throughout the year, our advocacy efforts extend further than the perimeter of our campus,  engaging local, state, and federal officials to help us accomplish our goals. 

 

Purpose 

The purpose of Student Government includes (but is not limited to) the following: 

Allocation of the Activity & Service Fee 

To provide official voice and action on behalf of the student body 

Ensure that students' concerns are addressed in the governance and policy development of Florida International University at all levels 

Evaluate and establish student programs and services 

Encourage the betterment of educational standards, facilities, and services

Contact: Black Student Union 

 

FIU’s Black Student Union (BSU) is a student-led programming bureau of the Student Government Association and is funded by student fees. BSU is open to all current FIU students. 

The purpose of BSU is to educate, advocate, and celebrate for and on behalf of students of the African Diaspora in the FIU community. We are in solidarity with all our students including but not limited to our LGBTQIA+ students, international students, and students with disabilities. It is important for us to not only act as allies for those whose identities are different from our own, but to specifically center the lives of those that are most marginalized.

FIU’s International Student Union (ISU) is a student-led programming bureau of the Student Government Association and is funded by student fees and private donations. All registered student organizations are open to all current FIU students. 

 

ISU is committed to making FIU a true “home away from home” for our international Panthers. Serving as a vibrant hub for connection, personal growth, and cultural exploration, ISU fosters a welcoming and inclusive community where international students can build lasting relationships with peers, broaden their perspectives, and excel academically, while enriching their overall college experience. ISU is dedicated to listening to the needs and concerns of international students, advocating for their interests, and providing supportive, peer-led guidance throughout their academic journey.
